WITH sma_10001_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', month_start) AS metric_time__day
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_count >= 1 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END AS __monthly_buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_count >= 2 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END AS __monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."member_monthly_summary" member_monthly_summary_model_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_8.monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_15.monthly_repeat_rate) AS monthly_repeat_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10001_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_8
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS monthly_repeat_rate
  FROM sma_10001_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_15

在 2026 年 8 月（统计范围为 2026-08-01 至 2026-09-01 自然月，覆盖全门店全渠道），青禾的会员指标表现如下：
- 月内购买会员数：16,504 个 CRM 会员账户（统计当月至少有一笔有效订单的会员账户）
- 月内复购会员数：7,302 个 CRM 会员账户（统计当月至少有两笔有效订单的会员账户）
- 月内复购率：44.24%（月内复购会员数 / 月内购买会员数）
